subject: Mutual Action Plan draft & milestones — Redwood / Novamed
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Rafi Khan <rafi.khan@novamed.com>, Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@novamed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 May 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Mutual Action Plan draft & milestones — Redwood / Novamed

Hi Rafi and Leah,

Thanks again for the call today — good discussion and clear priorities. I took notes and attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps milestones, owners, and dependencies based on what you walked us through. Highlights: 

- Target commercial close (signature) suggested: 2026-06-24 to align with your procurement window.
- Key milestones in the draft:
  • Pilot kickoff (technical kickoff / sandbox access) — target 2026-05-31 — owner: Novamed (Leah) / Redwood (Mina)
  • Integration & validation (API keys, sample data) — target 2026-06-10 — owner: Novamed Eng / Redwood SE (Jonas)
  • Legal redlines & SOW finalization — Redwood legal to turn around first pass by 2026-06-03; Novamed legal review by 2026-06-10
  • Procurement PO / signature — target 2026-06-24 — dependency: final SOW signed and SOC2 evidence uploaded

Dependencies called out in the MAP: SOC2 report access (we can provide SOC2 type II evidence via our portal), API access level for QA, and a single consolidated SOW rather than iterative mini-SOWs (to speed procurement).

Next steps I propose:
1) Please review the attached MAP (RWD_MAP_v1.1.pdf) and flag any changes to owners or milestones by EOD Friday 2026-05-08.
2) Leah — can you confirm whether the 2026-06-24 signature target is feasible with procurement? Any blackout dates or approval committee windows we should avoid?
3) Redwood: we’ll have Jonas (SE) shadow the integration tasks and Marissa (Sales Lead) will own commercial coordination & discounts.

If this schedule looks broadly ok I’ll lock the MAP and create a shared tracker (sheet + HubSpot milestones) and start weekly Friday standups at 10:00am PT.

Attachments: RWD_MAP_v1.1.pdf (MAP draft), Novamed_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (procurement info you shared today)

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Rafi Khan <rafi.khan@novamed.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Leah Barnes <leah.barnes@novamed.com>
Date: Thu, 07 May 2026 18:27:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft & milestones — Redwood / Novamed

Mina — thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Appreciate the level of detail. Quick notes from procurement/legal side after an internal sync: 

- Procurement lead time: our procurement team requires a signed SOW and commercial terms at least 7 business days before the finance approval window to process a PO. That effectively means we need final contract language by ~2026-06-15 to reliably get a PO processed and signed by 2026-06-24.
- Legal review: our counsel will need at least 10 business days for review/redlines unless we have a one-way SOW that they can accept (they prefer consolidated agreements).
- SOC2: we do a quick evidence pull; if you can provide a download link to the SOC2 Type II folder by 2026-05-20 that would help speed review.

I attached a short procurement checklist with milestone suggestions (Novamed_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx). Given timelines above, if Redwood can deliver final SOW draft by 2026-06-03 as you proposed, we should be in good shape. One ask — can Redwood commit to turning around any requested redline responses within 48 hours? That will make the 06/24 target realistic.

Other items: we have a vendor approval committee meeting on 2026-06-22; if the PO is in process then we should be fine. If you can accommodate the 48-hour redline SLA, we can accept the 2026-06-24 signature target.

– Rafi
Director of IT Procurement | Novamed Health
rafi.khan@novamed.com | +1 (617) 555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafi Khan <rafi.khan@novamed.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 May 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft & milestones — Redwood / Novamed

Thanks Rafi — that's helpful context and good to see the procurement committee date. Mina, flagging a couple of operational commitments from Redwood so we can confirm the MAP: 

1) Redwood commitments (can confirm):
   - Redwood legal to deliver initial cleaned SOW (v1.1 -> v1.2) with our standard commercial appendix by EOD 2026-06-03.
   - Redwood will prioritize redline responses within 48 hours of receiving edits.
   - SOC2 evidence link: we will post to the shared folder by 2026-05-20 (Jonas to follow up with upload).

2) Proposed update to milestones (to match procurement constraints):
   - Legal: Redwood initial SOW 2026-06-03; Novamed review complete by 2026-06-10.
   - Final SOW signed by both parties (target): 2026-06-17 — this gives procurement 5 business days to process a PO ahead of 06-22 committee (Rafi noted 7 business days; we’ll aim to compress where possible).
   - Commercial signature / PO processed: 2026-06-24 (contract effective date to follow).

If Novamed confirms they can prioritize the internal legal review window (06-03 -> 06-10) and commit to routing the SOW to procurement immediately, we’ll treat 06-24 as the canonical signature deadline. Mina — please update the MAP file to reflect Marissa's timeline and owners, and push the tracker to the HubSpot deal. Jonas — please confirm SOC2 upload ETA.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sales Lead, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Marissa / Mina — thanks for the adjustments and the commitments. Confirming Novamed will: 

- Prioritize legal review during 2026-06-03 -> 2026-06-10 window, with an internal expectation to escalate to counsel immediately upon receipt.
- Target final internal approvals so procurement can request the PO the week of 2026-06-15 (we'll aim for the earliest possible PO submission).
- We accept the canonical signature deadline of 2026-06-24 provided Redwood meets the 48-hour redline SLA and SOC2 evidence is uploaded by 2026-05-20.
